title: Tips for a Good Speech
subtitle: 考点：演讲技巧 / nervous / pay attention to
passage: Many students feel nervous when they speak in front of a class. Mr Green, an English teacher, gives some tips to help.

First, prepare carefully. Write down your main points and practise them aloud. If possible, ask a friend to be your listener and hold a rehearsal. Second, speak slowly and clearly. When people are nervous, they speak too fast, so take a deep breath before you start. Third, look at your listeners and smile. This shows that you are friendly and sincere.

Also, pay attention to your body. Stand up straight and do not play with your hair or pen. Last but not least, be yourself. You do not have to be perfect. Mr Green says that even good speakers make mistakes, but they simply continue and do not stop. “With practice, your fear will become smaller and smaller,” he says.
